text:
maria: Quick sync — I'm prototyping a smaller redis-cache StatefulSet config for rollout. On 3 replicas we're seeing OOMs on startup when the cluster is busy. Thinking of: 1) lowering requests/limits, 2) doing a partitioned rollout (keep stable pods), 3) temporarily scale to 2 with faster HPA, or 4) add an init container to warm cache. Any red flags? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2345

aj: do we know if pods are getting OOMKilled or node OOM? `kubectl describe pod` and `kubectl logs` would help.

devon: looks like `OOMKilled` in the pod status (kubelet evicted container), not node OOM. Probably preloading spike. Could we reduce memory requests and add `terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60`?

sasha: +1 to partitioned rollout. For StatefulSet set `updateStrategy.rollingUpdate.partition` so new pods don't roll all at once. Example:

```yaml
spec:
  updateStrategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      partition: 1
```

maria: thanks — is partition applied via Terraform resource? I'm editing the k8s manifest in the repo (infra).

aj: in terraform k8s provider it's under `spec.0.update_strategy.0.rolling_update.0.partition` in `kubernetes_stateful_set_v1`. sample snippet:

```hcl
resource "kubernetes_stateful_set_v1" "redis_cache" {
  spec {
    update_strategy {
      rolling_update {
        partition = 1
      }
      type = "RollingUpdate"
    }
    replicas = 3
    template { /* trimmed */ }
  }
}
```

devon: alternative: bump `podDisruptionBudget` minAvailable so k8s doesn't drop too many at once. Also check readinessProbe — if probe is too strict pods can be killed during rollout loop.

sasha: pro-tip on probe wiring: use a lightweight TCP or `redis-cli PING` exec check for startup readiness instead of a heavyweight HTTP probe that triggers preloading.

maria: ok will open a small PR to change partition -> 1, lower mem request from `1Gi` -> `600Mi`, and relax readiness for the first 30s. pinging @aj and @devon for quick review. I'll run the canary in staging after.

infra-bot: deploybot: Canary deployment started for infra PR #2345 — staging cluster — 2m ago :rocket:

aj: lgtm for terraform snippet, small nits on variable naming in the PR.

devon: can you add a short eval window and rollback policy? maybe 15m then auto-rollback to previous revision if errors > 2.

maria: added rollback policy + 15m eval window in the PR, and included the probe change. Thanks all :thumbsup:
